set -o pipefail
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && python -B - <<'EOF'
p = 'boltons/listutils.py'
s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
old = "            " + "del self.lists[:]\n            self.lists[0] = tmp_sorted\n"
new = "            self.lists[:] = [tmp_sorted]\n"
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(s.replace(old, new))
print('patched')
EOF

from boltons.listutils import BarrelList
# large multi-list case
bl = BarrelList(range(200000))
bl.insert(0, -1)
r = bl.sort()
assert r is None, r
assert len(bl) == 200001
assert list(bl) == sorted(list(range(200000)) + [-1])
# duplicates preserved
bl2 = BarrelList([3,1,2,1,3,2]*100000)
bl2.insert(0, 0)
bl2.sort()
assert list(bl2) == sorted([3,1,2,1,3,2]*100000 + [0])
# usable after
bl2.append(99); assert bl2[-1] == 99
# empty and small
e = BarrelList(); assert e.sort() is None and len(e)==0
s = BarrelList([3,1,2]); assert s.sort() is None and list(s)==[1,2,3]
print('all checks passed')
"
